ROAD CONDITIONS

Fish Creek Road is an Alaska State Highway that is maintained by CBJ, the road is plowed each morning prior to opening and will return as needed throughout the day. Eaglecrest is the highest road accessible in Juneau. Be prepared for winter driving and required use of 4WD, AWD, studded tires, or chains whenever necessary.

MOUNTAIN REPORT

Date:11/09/2026

Hello, and welcome back to the conditions reports for the 2026/27 ski season! We will begin posting regular updates closer to Opening Day, December 12th. For now, do your snow dances, bring your gear up to the ski shop (M – F: 9 AM-4 PM), watch some ski movies, do your leg strengthening, and anticipate another great winter at our favorite mountain! Ski you in no time.

NORDIC REPORT

The Nordic Report will be back for the 2026/27 season with daily operational updates and grooming updates to the upper and lower nordic trails.

OPERATIONS REPORT

Daily Operations Report – Eaglecrest Ski Area

Date: 04/30/2026

This daily report is provided to keep our community informed about current operations at Eaglecrest Ski Area. It includes important updates on ongoing maintenance, lift operations and repairs, utility or infrastructure issues, and any other operational matters that may impact access, safety, or the guest experience. Our goal is to offer transparency and timely information, so guests, staff, and partners know what to expect each day on the mountain.

  • Eaglecrest Ski Area is closed for the 2026 season.

  • The summer road at Eaglecrest Ski Area is currently being cleared. Unmarked hazards may be present, along with active machinery and maintenance staff in the area. Recreation is at your own risk, please use caution and follow all posted signage.

UPHILL ACCESS

UPHILL STATUS
See Mountain Report.

On operating days, uphill access is not permitted within the ski area boundary. There are three designated routes along the ski area boundary to access backcountry terrain, not Eaglecrest terrain. Please refer to the uphill route map and read the uphill policy.

Eaglecrest reserves the right to suspend uphill access at any time for ski patrol and mountain operations. This includes operating and non-operating days and hours. Uphill skiers, snowboarders, and hikers are using the area at their own risk and assume all responsibility. Always read the Mountain Report or call the Snow Phone before visiting.
